For the default 4-stage pipeline this is the Documentation agent. For non-standard compositions (e.g., verification-only \`["qa", "code-review"]\`), it is the agent owning the last active stage (e.g., Reviewer).

740	# ledger_add_insight
   741	
   742	Add a reusable insight to the global or repository-scoped knowledge base.
   743	
   744	## Required Parameters
   745	- **scope** (string): \`"global"\` for cross-repository insights; \`"repository"\` for repository-scoped insights.
   746	  When scope is \`"repository"\`, **repository_name is also required**.
   747	- **title** (string): Short title for the insight.
   748	- **content** (string): Full description of the insight.
   749	- **category** (string): Category string (e.g., \`"architecture"\`, \`"testing"\`, \`"workflow"\`, \`"security"\`).
   750	- **tags** (array): Array of tag strings for filtering and search.
   751	
   752	## Optional Parameters
   753	- **repository_name** (string): Name of the repository store. Required when scope is \`"repository"\`.
   754	  Alphanumeric characters, hyphens, and underscores only (e.g., \`"my-repo"\`). The name \`"global"\` is reserved and cannot be used.
   755	- **origin_plan** (string): Provenance metadata — the plan slug where this insight was first discovered or generated (e.g., \`"2026-05-29-knowledge-repository-scope"\`). Alphanumeric characters, hyphens, and underscores only. Optional; stored as-is for traceability.
   756	- **source** (string): Source reference (e.g., WP ID, discussion link, or URL). Defaults to empty string.
   757	- **confidence** (number): Confidence score 0–1 indicating reliability. Defaults to 1.
   758	
   759	## Response
   760	The created insight object, including the auto-assigned numeric **id** and a **formatted_id** (KN-NNNN).

   857	Immutable fields (id, scope, repository_name, created_at) cannot be changed.
   858	
   859	> **Tip:** Numeric IDs are per-store counters, so the same numeric ID (e.g. \`1\`) can exist

   861	> your intent unambiguous and prevent accidental global-insight mutation.
   862	
   863	## Required Parameters
   864	- **id** (number): Numeric insight ID (as returned in the \`id\` field of a previous response).
   865	
   866	## Optional Scope Parameters (recommended when IDs may overlap)
   867	- **scope** ("global" | "repository"): Restrict the search to stores of this scope.
   868	  Use \`"global"\` to ensure only the global store is searched; use \`"repository"\` combined
   869	  with \`repository_name\` to target a specific repository store exclusively.
   870	- **repository_name** (string): Restrict the search to a specific repository store.
